title: Mapping
description: A declarative mapping, written in YAML: one JSONata expression per target field, lookup tables as data, and fixtures that prove it works. A mapping is one-way; its flow says between which message and which canonical document.

version.description: Revision of this mapping. Every change that is saved gets the next number; a revision is promoted to production, never edited there.

direction.description: inbound: the message is the source and the canonical document the target. outbound: the other way round.

message.description: The message or file on the non-canonical side: a partner message or an ERP file.

type.description: Message type, for example ORDERS, or the name of an ERP file.

version.description: Directory or release of the message type, for example D.96A.

lookups.description: Lookup tables, by name, read in expressions as $lookups.<name>. Keys and values are strings; quote them in YAML, which reads 01 as the number 1.

fixtures.description: Sample inputs with the output they must give. A revision whose fixtures do not all pass cannot be promoted.

input.description: What the mapping reads, as JSON.

fields.description: The properties of an output object, by name.

field.description: A leaf has an `expression` and gives the value of the property. A group has `fields` and gives an object. A group with `forEach` gives an array: one object per item that the expression selects, in which `$` is that item.

expression.description: A JSONata expression. An undefined result leaves the property out.

forEach.description: A JSONata expression that selects the items to repeat the group for.

confidence.description: How sure the author is, often an AI assistant: high, medium or low. A mapping with a low-confidence field cannot be promoted until a person reviews it and raises or removes the value.

specRef.description: Where the specification describes this field, for review.

source.description: The document: a standard and its version, or a partner's implementation guide.

location.description: Where in the document: a section, a table or a segment.

note.description: Why the expression is written this way, for the next reader.
